Only Adult XS and Adult SM cost $21; Adult MD costs $42 and is excluded. Live merchant feed confirms both $21 sizes available. Stockings are included, so separate striped socks are optional for this choice. No dispatch estimate on product listing.

Orange buttoned bodice and broad white/orange/yellow skirt bands retain the palette, but have no corset lacing or stacked ruffles. Adult XS, Small, Large, XL and 1X are available; Medium, 2X and 3X are sold out. Socks in the photograph are sold separately. Page lists ready stock; no production lead time stated.
